newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers firm again, Mediterranean stable.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers firm again, Mediterranean stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices edged higher on Monday as a trading house again pushed the barge market higher, while Mediterranean prices were stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers gained about $2 to $90/$91 fob after one trading house bought around 13,000 tonnes of barges in the morning at prices between $88.50 and $90.00 fob.
Total ARA bunker market demand fell far short of barge market trade. Suppliers said the traded volume was about 7,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices rose sharply and business was brisk.
Suppliers said the steady gains of Rotterdam prices over the past few days and slight tightness of product were behind the stronger Hamburg numbers.
Fuel oil 380 CST was quoted at around $95/$97 fob.
Mediterranean prices barely changed and business was very slack.
"We didn't see many enquiries and fixtures were actually below zero if you take into account cancellations," said one supplier.
Egyptian bunkers were about $1 a tonne cheaper. Product was available in all ports.
